indicators: Typed function parameters and return values
Interfaces, type aliases or generic implementations
rubrics.caution: A dependency or extension alone is an observation, not proof of implementation or personal mastery.

indicators: Asynchronous logic, events or data transformation
rubrics.caution: Do not infer individual authorship from repository ownership.

indicators: Components with state, props or event behavior
Hooks used in a functional feature
rubrics.caution: A React dependency without implementation is only observed technology.

indicators: Route handlers or application page implementations
Server/client boundaries or data loading in application code
rubrics.caution: Configuration alone does not prove application implementation.

indicators: Semantic markup implementing a user-facing structure
Labeled forms or accessible document structure
rubrics.caution: Boilerplate markup does not establish personal proficiency.

indicators: Selectors and rules implementing layout or responsive behavior
rubrics.caution: Only cite the presentation behavior actually present in the excerpt.

indicators: Executable assertions for meaningful feature behavior
Fixtures and failure cases exercising application logic
rubrics.caution: A runner dependency is not evidence that relevant tests were implemented or executed.

indicators: Project automation using explicit version-control operations
rubrics.caution: Repository existence or a GitHub URL does not demonstrate version-control skill; report insufficient evidence when history is unavailable.

indicators: Workflow steps implementing build, test or deployment automation
rubrics.caution: Configuration can support observed technology; implementation claims additionally require eligible source or test evidence.

indicators: Utility classes implementing actual responsive components
rubrics.caution: A dependency alone is observed technology, not verified mastery.
